payload.body: The AFK autonomy gate refused this store at step 1a while the founding act was agent-attributed and constitution_signed_by read 'pending'. The remedy is a human-actor command; an agent running it would forge the signature the gate exists to require, so the AFK run could not start. The workflow's own carve-out — 'Interactive work is ungated: this gate binds AFK runs only' — is the legitimate path: the same rigor, journaled decisions, no forged act. The human ratified on 2026-08-24 (config.updated by human:maintainer), clearing founding.unsigned.
